_comment: THE BASE. Every other language is a translation of this file, and this
is the file a missing translation falls back to.
1. NO NUMBERS THAT MOVE. Not one body states a price, a credit cost, an
allowance or a plan limit. Those live in lib/billing/plans.ts and on
/pricing, they change, and a stale number here is a quote a customer
will hold us to. Money questions point at /pricing instead.
2. NOTHING PERSONAL. An article is identical for every reader, so it may
only answer a question about the PRODUCT. 'How many credits do I have
left' is a question about one account and must reach the real path.
triggers are what a person actually types. They are matched
accent-insensitively and only inside this locale — an English trigger
can never hand an English answer to someone reading in French.

what-is-ionexa.title: What is Ionexa?
what-is-ionexa.body:
A workspace where you say what you want and it happens: it builds websites, runs agents that work on their own schedule, breaks goals down into steps, and reads your files so it can answer questions about them.

Instead of ten separate tools that do not talk to each other, one that knows about all of it.

languages.title: What languages does it work in?
languages.body:
The interface is available in ten languages and you switch it in Settings.

The AI replies in whatever language you write to it, regardless of the interface language — so you can keep the interface in English and still chat in your own language.

mobile-app.title: Is there a mobile app?
mobile-app.body:
Ionexa installs on your phone straight from the browser — open it and choose "Add to Home Screen".

It behaves like a normal app, with its own icon and notifications, without going through an app store.

pricing-overview.title: How much does Ionexa cost?
pricing-overview.body:
There is a free plan so you can try it, and paid plans as your needs grow.

Current prices and what each plan includes are always on the pricing page. They are not repeated here on purpose — a stale number is worse than no number.

change-plan.title: How do I change my plan?
change-plan.body:
Settings → Billing. Pick the plan you want and the change takes effect straight away.

On an upgrade you pay only the difference for the rest of the current period. On a downgrade you keep your current plan until the period you have already paid for ends.

cancel.title: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.body:
Settings → Billing → Cancel subscription. It takes one click to reach and one to confirm.

You do not lose access immediately: your plan runs to the end of the period you have already paid for, and only then does the account move to the free plan. Nothing is deleted — your data, files and websites stay exactly where they are.

Changed your mind? The same screen lets you restore the subscription at any point before it ends.

invoices.title: Where do I find my receipts?
invoices.body:
Settings → Billing → Payment history. Every charge has a PDF receipt you can download from there.

Payments are handled by Stripe and we never store your card details.

refund.title: Can I ask for a refund?
refund.body:
Yes — tell us what happened and we will look at it. If you were charged by mistake, or something did not work the way it should have, we will put it right.

Message us from Settings → Support and include the charge reference so we can find it quickly.

what-are-credits.title: What are credits?
what-are-credits.body:
Credits are what you spend on AI work: a chat message, building a website, an agent run.

Every plan includes a monthly allowance that renews, and you can buy extra packs if you run out sooner. Credits from a pack do not expire at the end of the month — they stay on the account until you use them.

How much each plan includes is on the pricing page.

credit-cost-per-action.title: How many credits does each action cost?
credit-cost-per-action.body:
There is no fixed price per action. The charge is worked out from the real cost of each call, so a short message costs less than a long one.

Before anything expensive you see an estimate, and once it finishes you see the actual charge in your history.
triggers: how many credits does it cost

credits-ran-out.title: I have run out of credits — what now?
credits-ran-out.body:
Two options: wait for the next monthly renewal, or buy a credit pack that is added immediately.

Pack credits do not expire at the end of the month, so nothing you buy is lost at the next renewal. Both options are in Settings → Billing.

credits-rollover.title: Do credits carry over to the next month?
credits-rollover.body:
Your plan's monthly credits renew each month and do not accumulate.

Credits you buy in a pack are different: they stay on your account until you spend them, through renewals, plan changes and cancellation alike.

create-website.title: How do I build a website?
create-website.body:
Open Website Builder from the side menu, describe in plain words what you want — what your business does, who it is for, what style you like — and press create.

You can upload reference images too, such as a logo or product photos, and it will follow your style. When it is ready you publish it to its own address with one click.
triggers: how do i build a website
how do i make a website

publish-website.title: How do I publish my website?
publish-website.body:
In Website Builder, open the site and press Publish. You choose a name for the address and the site goes live straight away.

Every publish is kept as a version, so you can go back to an earlier one whenever you need to.

create-agent.title: How do I create an agent?
create-agent.body:
In the Agents menu, describe in one sentence what you want it to do and how often — for example "every morning send me a summary of news in my industry".

Ionexa builds the agent for you, runs it on schedule and sends you the result. You can pause it or change it whenever you like.
triggers: how do i create an agent

create-mission.title: How do I create a mission?
create-mission.body:
In Mission Control you write a goal the way you would say it to a person — "I want more customers by spring".

Ionexa breaks it into concrete steps, and from there you can work through them yourself or hand some of them to an agent.
triggers: how do i create a mission

chat-memory.title: Does the chat remember previous conversations?
chat-memory.body:
Within a single conversation it always remembers what was said earlier.

Between conversations it keeps only lasting, useful facts — your name, what you do, your preferences — and that is available on paid plans. You can see everything it has kept, and delete any of it, in Settings → Memory.

upload-files.title: Can I upload files?
upload-files.body:
Yes — PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, plain text and Markdown. Upload them in Files, Ionexa reads their contents, and then you can ask questions about them.

Your files are private: nobody else has access, and every download goes through a temporary link.

connect-gmail.title: How do I connect Gmail or Google Drive?
connect-gmail.body:
Settings → Connections. Pick the service and approve access in Google's own window.

You see exactly what it will read before you approve, and you can disconnect whenever you want — the access keys are deleted immediately when you do.

password-reset.title: I forgot my password.
password-reset.body:
On the sign-in page press "Forgot my password" and enter your email address. A reset link will be sent to you.

If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.

invite-code.title: Where do I enter an invite code?
invite-code.body:
There is a field for it on the sign-up form.

If you already have an account, enter it in Settings → Account. Whatever it grants is applied to your account as soon as it goes through.
triggers: where do i enter the code

team-members.title: Can I add people from my team?
team-members.body:
Yes, on the plans that include a team. Go to Settings → Team, invite by email, and that person joins the same workspace.

Which plans include it, and how many seats they give, is on the pricing page.

notifications.title: How do I manage notifications?
notifications.body:
Settings → Notifications. Email and phone notifications are controlled separately, and so is each type — agent results, reminders, low credits.

Critical security notifications cannot be switched off.

contact-support.title: How do I reach a human?
contact-support.body:
Settings → Support, and write to us.

If it is about a charge, include the charge reference so we can find it quickly.

data-privacy.title: What do you do with my data?
data-privacy.body:
Your data is yours. We do not sell it, we do not use it to train models, and every account sees only its own — that is enforced in the database, not just in the application.

You can download it or delete it whenever you want.

export-data.title: Can I download my data?
export-data.body:
Yes. Settings → Account → Export data.

You get a file with everything you have created — conversations, missions, websites, files, billing history. Access keys for connected accounts are left out for security reasons.

delete-account.title: How do I delete my account?
delete-account.body:
Settings → Account → Delete account. You will be asked to confirm, and then everything goes: conversations, files, websites, agents, history. It cannot be undone.

If you want a copy first, export your data from the same page.
